rules.statement: A power of attorney holder does not have locus standi to be named as a party and appear in revision proceedings under the Maintenance Act No. 37 of 1999, unless the power of attorney explicitly grants such authority.
rules.supporting_quote: It is a fundamental principle of the law relating to power of attorneys that the authority conferred upon an attorney must be strictly construed, and that an attorney cannot act beyond the scope of the authority expressly granted.
rules.statute_citation_verbatim: Section 8 of the Maintenance Act, No. 37 of 1999
